paragraphs.text: The Questing Beast is a legendary sapient beast from Eldraine .

The Questing Beast is a legendary sapient beast with both cat -like and reptilian -like features, who acts to choose candidates for the High Quest and gifts them with magical blessed swords. It has three long necks and three faces, one angry, one solemn, and one laughing.
Rankle and Mags once made it cry.
